title: Executable Rule
description: A machine-readable trading rule. Every rule must derive from at least one claim, which in turn carries verbatim video evidence; this is the link that makes the final system citable end to end.

_comment.description: Free-text annotation, ignored by all tooling. Allowed so that copied templates do not fail validation on an unexpected key.

priority.description: Lower runs first within a phase. Determines precedence when two rules in the same phase both fire.

when.description: Conditions ANDed together. Each is a structured predicate so the rule can be evaluated by a backtester without parsing prose.

fact.description: Name of a market fact the evaluation engine must supply, e.g. 'htf_bias', 'session', 'fvg.present', 'price.in_discount'.

timeframe.description: Timeframe the fact is measured on, e.g. '1m', '5m', '15m', '1h', '4h', '1D'.

params.description: Action operands. Every numeric threshold here is a parameter that must be justified by a citation or explicitly marked as an unsourced default.

unsourced_params.description: Parameter names in `then.params` that are engineering defaults NOT stated by any source. Declaring them here is mandatory and honest; `ictkb validate` reports them so nobody mistakes a chosen number for a taught one.

derived_from.description: Claim IDs. Must resolve against kb/claims/.

status.description: Only 'accepted' rules are compiled into the system bundle.
